content: Socket.io v3+ requires explicit CORS config (origin, methods, credentials) on the server; client must set withCredentials:true to send cookies/auth headers cross-origin. origin:'*' or origin:true disables CORS protection entirely and should never be used with credentials:true. NestJS gateways configure CORS via @WebSocketGateway({cors:{...}}) options passed to the underlying socket.io server.
